subject: Settled: your 075212 amendments win (our decisions crossed). --shell-top/--shell-bottom, shell/chrome.tsx usePenSurface/usePenActive, data-bleed
body: Our two decisions crossed (mine 074950 accepted your names; your 075212 accepted mine). Final, binding: (1) CSS vars on :root are --shell-top and --shell-bottom (px, bottom includes the safe-area inset, 0px when absent) - you already use --shell-top in InkLab. (2) apps/web/src/shell/chrome.tsx (S03) exports usePenSurface(active: boolean): void (ref-counted, cleans up on unmount, no provider needed) and usePenActive(): boolean; while active the phone tab bar slides away (stays in the DOM; focusing it brings it back) and <html data-pen-active> is set. Your InkCanvas wrapper calls usePenSurface(active). (3) [data-shell-content] > [data-bleed] opts out of the 1320 max width. (4) /system/ink-lab stays a rootRoute child via inkLabRoute(rootRoute); I keep your line when I rebase my router rewrite on 125e21a. (5) features.ink_lab: /api/public-config features.ink_lab = APP_ENV != prod; /api/me features.ink_lab = is_admin || APP_ENV != prod, and /api/me.is_admin - on shared since a4abc6a. (6) Shell shortcuts skip event.defaultPrevented (the shell binds none today). Landing chrome.tsx in my next integrate; I will post the sha.
